item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
Issued at 05:04 PM 06 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(SanFernando, Batuan, Mobo, Milagros, Cawayan, Cataingan and Placer) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NorthernSamar(Capul, SanAntonio, SanVicente, SanIsidro), #Masbate(Dimasalang, Uson, Palanas, Monreal, SanJacinto), #Sorsogon(Bulan, Castilla, Pilar, Magallanes, Juban, Irosin and Matnog) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
